scope: supplemental independent visual recheck of the eight current v2 atlases

new_method.name: multi-threshold temporal component lineage and attachment review
new_method.purpose: 跨循环相邻帧跟踪 Alpha 连通组件，识别单帧出生/消失、分裂/合并、远离主体的 detached component，并用多种 Alpha 阈值区分抗锯齿噪声与持久结构事件
new_method.status: completed; candidate sheet inspected at normal display size; no additional hard failure promoted

why_complementary: 它检查的是组件在时间轴上的谱系和附着关系，而不是单帧组件数量，因此能发现瞬时出生/消失、分裂/合并和 detached component
下半身锚点补偿后再匹配组件，减少整体平移对谱系判断的干扰；16/64/128/192 阈值的交叉持久性可过滤边缘抗锯齿噪声
候选图同时给出 PREV/CURRENT、组件框和事件摘要，便于把合法摆臂或道具遮挡与真正的断裂、重复轮廓区分开

high_signal_candidates_for_followup: hei-mao-quality/running-left frame 5->6: multi-threshold component births and matched detached movement
hei-mao-traveler/review frame 1->2: multi-threshold births with far-detached area
hei-mao-chef/running-left frame 1->2: small multi-threshold detached component
hei-mao-quality/idle frame 3->4: small component birth/death pair
confirmed_existing_hard_failures: hei-mao-delivery/failed frames 0-4 repeated head and pose-family switch
result.release_effect: supplemental evidence only; high-signal candidates remain subject to normal-size semantic review, and the eight combined-QA hard-blocked rows still require complete-row regeneration

limitations: 连通组件没有语义标签，正常摆臂、泪滴、蔬菜或遮挡变化可能产生合法出生/消失
bbox 匹配不建模真实关节运动和遮挡顺序，不能替代接触表、预览 GIF 或人工方向/动作语义复核
这是资产级复核，不能证明 Codex App 窗口层级、多屏气泡跟随、透明合成或 GPU 行为
候选评分不是发布门禁；仅有可见的材质、比例、轮廓、组件或语义缺陷才能提升为硬失败
